Author: Hunters' Guild
Title: Wasteland Marketplace Opening Soon
Content:
Welcome, hunters, to the Wasteland. Here, you can use your skills to earn and trade for anything you want.
But remember, the Hunters' Guild has sacred rules that must be followed. To avoid unnecessary conflict, please stick to these three trade rules:
(1) Items looted from the battlefield can only be traded once safely brought back to the Wasteland.
(2) Every item has its own unique value. Set your price freely.
(3) A trade is only valid if both sides agree to it.
Hunters, get ready and move out. Treasure and the goddess of luck are waiting for you.
